blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–CJ Perez believes San Miguel Beer can still perform beyond expectations even if momentum has swung in their favor going into the deciding Game 5 of their PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series against Barangay Ginebra. The Beermen will look to become just the fourth team in history to overcome a 0-2 deficit to win a best-of-five series when they face the Gin Kings on Tuesday at Ynares Center in Antipolo. Perez credited San Miguel’s turnaround to its defensive effort and by matching Ginebra’s energy, though he still sees the need to amp up their game with a semis berth and […]...
